'''Gyax''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked for the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] thugs on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was [[Oskara]]'s mentor when she offered her services to the gang leader as an "experienced [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]."<ref name="EotEBG">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game]]</ref>
